reviewer: Codex; diagnostic image inspection, no human art approval
inspection_basis: Final default, tall/zoomed and odd-physical captures were inspected directly. Final minimum/large-UI and below-minimum captures are pixel-identical to the reviewed layout-final versions; their source SHA/capture hashes are checked in validation-evidence.json.
observations: The gold content border encloses fixed-aspect world output. Every native checker block agrees with the measured integer physical scale. Wide/tall bars and odd right/bottom remainders preserve framing.

Native HUD/pointer are visibly distinct from the low-resolution world. All reported HUD bounds fit above content, including UI 1.5 at 640x480 logical. Minimum diagnostics replace the hidden world without covering the HUD.

Terrain labels are world-pixel fixtures; their fine detail at zoom 1 is not a production font or art acceptance claim. Gold/violet capsules preserve their continuous non-grid anchors and distinct local floor scope.
Automated captures deliberately show disabled controls while checks run. Controls are enabled when interactive execution starts; no human interaction is inferred.

resolved_findings.finding: Unsupported %g formatting caused engine errors and unreadable placeholder text. Replaced with supported, bounded numeric formats.
Long floating-point camera text clipped at the largest UI/minimum window. Precision, layout and the independently scaled HUD were corrected; native bounds now enforce the fix.

not_run: External/1x displays and alternate OS scaling
Human concept/art approval, camera-motion stability and packaged exports (later tickets)
